verdict.rationale: The getting-started docs show installation from a prebuilt Docker image (`docker run ... localai/localai:latest`). The homepage describes LocalAI as "one binary", and the docs say the matching prebuilt GPU or CPU backend is downloaded automatically, so no compilation is needed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of downloadable release binaries or OS package managers (e.g., brew/apt/installer script), independent hands-on corroboration of non-source installs.
